subject: PHI scope decision matrix & BAA ask
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@carebridge.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: PHI scope decision matrix & BAA ask

Hi Samir — great to connect earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our HIPAA scoping discussion so we have everything on the same page.

Recap (from call)
- Primary product flow: provider notes ingestion + classification + structured extraction. Some free-text fields (notes) will include identifiers.
- PHI types expected: patient name, MRN, DOB, clinical notes, limited imaging metadata (no raw images).
- Volume: pilot ~50k records/month; production target ~1M records/month.
- Query pattern: real-time enrichment for web UIs (low latency), plus batch backfill jobs.

High-level eligibility and recommendations
- Hosted API (public/shared): NOT eligible for PHI under our standard offering.
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pools): Eligible, supports BAA and customer isolation; recommended for low-latency interactive flows.
- Private (VPC or on-prem): Eligible, recommended if you require customer-managed networking, HSM/KMS integration, or air-gapped processing.

Attachments I’m sending with this note
- phi-decision-matrix.xlsx — matrix mapping PHI types to hosting modes and controls (initial draft).
- redwood_baa_template_v2.pdf — our standard BAA draft for Dedicated/Private deployments.

Asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm whether CareBridge will send any raw images (DICOM) as part of the integration? If yes, we’ll need to validate storage/processing constraints.
2) Please share the procurement/security contact (email) so we can kick off the vendor questionnaire and upload the SOC 2 summary.
3) If Dedicated or Private looks right, do you have a target date for pilot readiness? We’ll draft a mutual action plan once procurement is looped in.

I’ve CC’d Karthik and Marissa to help with pricing and onboarding logistics. I’ll also loop in our security lead for questionnaire responses once we have a contact.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Samir / Priya — thanks, and appreciate the procurement contact. Answers inline below and next steps.

1) Hosted + de-id: Our hosted shared API does not support PHI even with pre-processing on your side. The constraint is contractual and infrastructure-level (no BAA, no customer-dedicated isolation). If you can fully guarantee irreversible de-identification before sending to us, we can evaluate on a case-by-case basis, but the standard recommendation for anything that can contain identifiers is Dedicated or Private.

2) SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in Q4 2026. I’m attaching a redacted summary for your security team (SOC2-cert-2026-summary.pdf) and a link to our secure report portal: https://redwood.example.com/soc2/2026-summary. We’ll provide the full report under NDA if needed.

3) DICOM/raw images: If you anticipate raw image processing later, Private (on-prem) or a VPC-based private deployment is preferred — we need to evaluate storage cost and any GPU pre-processing constraints. Dedicated can handle metadata and derived features; raw image pipelines will require additional infra conversations.

Attachments: redwood_baa_template_v2.pdf (BAA draft), phi-decision-matrix.xlsx (matrix), SOC2-cert-2026-summary.pdf (redacted).

Proposed next steps:
- Priya: if you can confirm which hosting option you prefer (Dedicated or Private) and provide a target pilot date, we’ll:
  a) provision a Dedicated capacity quote and draft MSA/BAA for review, or
  b) open a Private intake for network/ops requirements.
- I’ll open a HubSpot deal and share a DocuSign for the initial BAA draft for your legal to redline.
- Neha (cc) will follow up with the vendor security questionnaire and any additional evidence requests.

Is EOD next Wed (7/7) a reasonable target for us to have an initial MSA/BAA draft in your hands?

Thanks — Logan

—

Looping in a short evidence checklist for Priya/security so we’re aligned on what CareBridge should expect from our team:
- SOC 2 Type II summary (attached) — we can provide full report under NDA.
- BAA: standard draft provided; redline cycle expected.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit; KMS integration available for Private deployments.
- Access controls: RBAC with SSO (SAML/OIDC) and audit logs retained 365 days (longer retention available as an add-on).
- Data residency / deletion: documented procedures — will need to map to CareBridge retention policy.
- Additional attachments: phi-handling-matrix.xlsx (I’ll upload a second version with control mappings if helpful).

If Priya can share any specific compliance checklist items or the vendor questionnaire link, I’ll coordinate answers. Also tagging Marissa for any procurement or pricing constraints.
